title: Write the LAMBO CITY ALIVE operator guide
vision: Create docs/LAMBO_CITY_ALIVE_OPERATOR_GUIDE.md as a concise, practical internal guide explaining how creative direction becomes a bounded development task, how the right specialist is selected, how code is proposed in an isolated workspace, how automated tests and draft pull request review work, and where owner approval and release gates apply. Clearly distinguish capabilities that are implemented and tested in the repository today from future integrations that are not yet connected. Reflect the approved first-launch business direction: balanced Create, Experience, and Earn pillars; owned LAMBO CITY products first; creator earning only later when licensing, rights, payment, tax, privacy, and operational readiness are established. Explain that the eventual owner experience should be plain-language direction through the ALIVE control surface, not requiring the owner to edit JSON or use GitHub. Do not claim that the live website currently has an AI control panel, that workers run continuously in the background, or that production deploys autonomously.
acceptanceCriteria: The guide accurately separates implemented, tested capabilities from planned but unconnected services.
The guide explains specialist task scope, isolated proposals, test gates, draft PR review, and owner-controlled merge and release.
The guide documents the balanced first-launch pillars and owned-products-first commerce direction without introducing seller payouts or a third-party marketplace as launch requirements.
The guide explains the intended plain-language owner workflow without claiming that the current queue prototype is already an end-user interface.
The document is concise, actionable, and contains no secrets or unsupported claims.
